name: codex-shadow-mind
description: Parallel read-only reviewer agents that watch Codex edit code and report architectural drift, invented APIs, and premature completion claims back into the main agent's context.

interface.shortDescription: Background reviewers that audit Codex while it codes
interface.longDescription: Runs specialised read-only reviewer agents alongside the main Codex session. After every few edits a shadow reviews the recent transcript and reports concrete findings through additionalContext; at end of turn a completion gate can send Codex back to finish work it declared done. Shadows are plain Markdown files you can edit or add to.
defaultPrompt: Show me which shadow minds are active and what they last reported.
Add a shadow mind that reviews test coverage after each change.
